items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Leon Scotty... because he made me a lead sheet.

ctx.x: You might want to tell the player. Huh?

Well I can, I might can obtain it from you, for you rather, from Leon Scotty. Leon Scotty, we called him Scotty, his name is Scott Leon Scotty, the trumpet player, because he made me a lead sheet. And I had, I gave Brother Montgomery the money, to send the money in to have it copyrighted, you know? And so I'll write to him right away. I'll write tonight or this afternoon and tell him to make me up a lead sheet. Now he may charge two or three dollars for that, you understand? But he will do it for me. He's a nice…
Then you became, even when you played with all those bigger band reading matches, you still play ad-libs?
